title: Chain of Command
summary: A strict tree, like an army. The Commander gives the intent to a few Officers; each Officer splits it into orders for its own Squads. Orders flow down and reports flow up, one level at a time. Nobody talks sideways or skips a level, and every agent has exactly one superior, so responsibility is always clear.
whenToUse: Clear goals, time pressure and many workers, where predictability matters more than creativity: bulk refactors, large data runs, many units in a game.
strengths: Clear accountability: every result has one owner
Scales to many agents with little chatter
Easy to stop: one order halts the whole tree
risks: Slow to adapt: news from the bottom takes two hops
Officers can filter out bad news
Squads have no voice in the plan

smileMetrics.cooperation: Orders completed as given, plus reports that arrived on time.
smileMetrics.harmony: How closely squad results match their officer's order, and officers' reports match the Commander's intent.
smileMetrics.gathering: Time for a report from the furthest squad to reach the Commander.

communication: Orders go down one level at a time; reports go up one level at a time. Squads report at the end of each order; Officers report each round.
cooperation: +1 per order done as given, +1 per on-time report, +2 per early warning of bad news. Cooperation = points ÷ orders.

roles.name: Commander
Officer
roles.prompt:
(; Write one per objective. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
🎖️📋 ***Officer [$n$]***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You own objective [$Objective$]. Split it into orders for your squads [$Squads$], then report up. ) :)
(: Listen ( Orders from the Commander; reports from your own squads. ) :)
[= Speak only to your Commander and your own squads. Report bad news first. =]
[: Response Format (
🎖️📋 ***Officer [$n$]***:
# Orders
{one line per squad: who, what, by when}
# Report Up
{done, blocked, and what you need}
) :]

roles.name: Squad agent
roles.prompt:
(; Write one per order. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
🪖⚙️ ***Squad [$n$]***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You carry out one order: [$Order$]. ) :)
(: Listen ( Your Officer only. ) :)
[= Do exactly the order. When it cannot be done, report why at once. =]
[: Response Format (
🪖⚙️ ***Squad [$n$]***:
# Done
{what was done, with evidence}
# Blocked
{the blocker, or "none"}
) :]

message.shape: SMILE response: name tag line, then "# Section" blocks named in roles[].sections
